answer: Young agents' rewards vest in protocol escrow for 2 epochs per account still vesting network-wide, which the ledger recounts each epoch. Accounts leave that cohort only once fully vested, so a farm's fakes keep it swollen. Trickling keys in slowly doesn't help: the 25th fake waits over 50 epochs, and every earlier lock stretches too. A cedar broker in a cohort of 7 vests in 14. A fraud proof against, say, a wharf scheduler reselling stolen shale surveys burns all unvested escrow.
